Subject: Follow-up & next steps after today's discovery

Hi Claire / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for your patient-facing summarization service while keeping costs within current budget envelope.
- Key constraints: HIPAA controls, on-prem access to EHR cluster for high-sensitivity pipelines, and preferred monthly spend target.
- Success metric: 2x latency improvement p95 for 512-token requests with no more than 15% increase in unit costs.

Next step we agreed on: a technical deep-dive (45–60m) with your engineering and infra folks to validate network access patterns and to walk through our recommended deployment options (Hosted API vs Dedicated pool vs Private VPC).

To make scheduling simple, can you pick one of these windows? Both are in PST:
- Option A: Wed, Mar 8 — 10:00–11:00 AM PST
- Option B: Thu, Mar 9 — 2:30–3:30 PM PST

Please confirm which works and who from your side will attend (roles preferred: infra lead, security/compliance, and the person owning the ML pipeline).

I'll put a provisional hold and include a short agenda + a diagram of the proposed PoC architecture.

Attachments: redwood_poc-outline.pdf (overview), arch-diagram.png (high-level network)

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[jasmine@redwood.com]
